label: r4c2
name: r3c3 + n_envs 64
hypothesis: Same as r3c3, but with 64 parallel worlds and 8 minibatches of 128 samples. The policy then updates about 120 times instead of 60, on fresher data, with the same samples and gradient steps. Its seed-0 run was ahead early (0.25 training success at 25% of training, against about 0.02 for r3c3), and the global context in the head may make use of that speed. Refuted if 2-seed dev success is below about 0.87.
